summary: Primech Holdings Ltd, a Singapore-based Nasdaq-listed facility services provider, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release titled 'Provides Update on Legal Proceedings.' The filing discloses litigation commenced August 7, 2026 in the Singapore High Court against former Primech AI CTO Zhang Youwei over HYTRON robot development, seeking transfer of 292,036 Primech shares held on trust plus damages. Zhang filed a defense and counterclaim on September 15, 2026, denying claims and seeking an RMB 6.0 million bonus, SGD 39,600 notice pay, and damages against the company, Primech AI, and CEO Ho. Proceedings are early-stage; no special-situation transaction events are present.
